messages:
sara_equnox: Hi team — Equinox Health here. We have a new request to onboard a domain-specific reorder-routing model for prescriptions. Primary asks: PHI-safe handling, deterministic rerank for audit, and custom region routing for EU patients. Need guidance on timeline and evals.

maria_cs: Thanks Sara — looping in Solutions and Security. Can you share expected QPS and whether model will see raw PHI or tokenized inputs?

sara_equnox: QPS ~ 20 req/s peak, mostly short sequences. The model will see raw PHI (patient names, meds) inside request body; we want Redwood Private in VPC, plus a BAA.

raj_solutions: Got it. Private deployment + BAA makes sense. For deterministic rerank we usually pin model + disable sampling and set seed. Also recommend KV-prefix caching off for auditable traces.

oliver_security: @sara_equnox Security notes: we'll need a dataflow diagram, retention TTL for logs, and KMS integration. Also propose redaction at ingestion if you can remove direct identifiers before sending.

jin_ml: For evaluation — what metrics matter? Precision@1 for correct routing, false positive rate for sensitive PHI leakage, and generation diffs vs baseline. We can run a 2-week eval with their sample prompts.

sara_equnox: Precision@1 is primary, must be >= 98% on our validation set. We can share a de-identified dataset of 2k examples by EOD Tue. Retention TTL: 30 days, must be configurable.

maria_cs: Noted. I'll kick off an intake ticket and schedule a 30-min scoping call. @raj_solutions can you prepare a checklist for Private onboarding (network, certs, model pinning, rollback)?

raj_solutions: Yep — checklist items: VPC peering, customer CIDR, KMS key ARN, model artifact location, desired quantization (fp16/int8), canary window, SLOs. Also ask if they need dedicated capacity snapshots.

oliver_security: One more — we should run a safety eval for prompt injection and PHI exfil tests. @jin_ml can you own the test harness?

jin_ml: I can. I'll create an eval suite: injection vectors, hallucination probes, and a privacy leakage metric (PII recall). Need their de-id set + 100 red-team prompts.

sara_equnox: We'll provide the artifacts. Also want to confirm billing implications for Private + dedicated GPUs and the timeline — renewal in 60 days so this is time-sensitive.

maria_cs: Understood — I'll flag as renewal-risk and request Finance to fast-track pricing.

onboard-bot: Intake ticket CREATED: CS-2026-4867. Assigned: raj_solutions, oliver_security. Scoping call scheduled: 1934654300 (calendar invite sent).

sara_equnox: Thanks all. Can we aim for a canary in 3 weeks after eval results? If any blockers, ping me ASAP.

raj_solutions: Sounds doable if we get their dataset by Tue. I'll draft the Private deployment runbook and share before the call.

maria_cs: I'll follow up with Finance and legal on BAA. Tagging @sara_equnox for any missing items. :thumbsup:

sara_equnox: Great — appreciate the quick turnaround.
